init.title: Map options
init.description:
![Map preview]({preview_url})

The picture updates when you submit with Update preview. Choose Save to keep this look on the camera.

clean_rooms.name: Clean Rooms
clean_rooms.description: Start cleaning specific rooms by their IDs.

room_ids.name: Room IDs
room_ids.description: List of room IDs to clean. Can be a JSON array like [1, 2] or comma-separated like 1, 2.

clean_times.name: Clean Times
clean_times.description: Number of times to clean each room (1-3).

clean_square.name: Clean Square
clean_square.description: Clean one square. x and y are the centre in centimetres. size is the side length in centimetres.

x.name: Centre X
x.description: Centre X in centimetres, same frame as the robot pose.

y.name: Centre Y
y.description: Centre Y in centimetres, same frame as the robot pose.

size.name: Side length
size.description: Side length in centimetres, from 50 to 2000.

clean_times.name: Clean Times
clean_times.description: Number of times to clean the square (1-3).

map_point.name: Map Point
map_point.description: Room and zone under a point on the map picture.

x.name: X
x.description: Horizontal fraction of the picture, 0 to 1.

y.name: Y
y.description: Vertical fraction of the picture, 0 to 1.

clean_area.name: Clean Area
clean_area.description: Clean a rectangle on the map picture.

set_zones.name: Set Zones
set_zones.description: Replace no-go and no-mop zones. Virtual walls are kept.

nogo.name: No-go
nogo.description: Rectangles as x1, y1, x2, y2 picture fractions.

nomop.name: No-mop
nomop.description: Rectangles as x1, y1, x2, y2 picture fractions.
